en: A monochrome postcard-style photograph showing a baroque church with a tall bell tower topped by an onion-shaped dome and cross, situated along a narrow street framed by multi‑story townhouses. To the left of the church stands a slender stone obelisk or column monument with relief decorations at its base. Overhead electrical or tram wires cross the sky. The scene appears quiet with a few small figures near the monument, and there is a simple chapel-like building just behind the church tower.
